title: Nine Men's Morris flying rule: down to three pieces, Ulfstan flies corner to corner for the last mill (real AI vs AI match in Millfall)
text:
In Millfall (pixel-art Nine Men's Morris), closing a mill means your unit executes an enemy unit. Once a side is down to three pieces it can fly: it may move a piece to any empty point, and the game shows flying units as ghosts. This is the real end of a match in the Moss Grove, both sides played by the game's own AI: Malgrim flies in to close a mill for Dusk, then Ulfstan, also down to three, flies from one corner of the board to the other, closes the last mill and wins it for Dawn. Recorded in-engine.

Millfall on the Microsoft Store (Windows PC): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd

title: Death by bonk: one of the warrior's executions in Millfall
text:
In Millfall (pixel-art Nine Men's Morris), closing a mill means your unit executes an enemy unit, and warriors and mages each have their own executions. This one is Bonk: a Dusk warrior walks over and knocks a Dawn unit on the head with a sword pommel, stars circle, and the unit sways and keels over. Recorded in-engine in the Ember Forge arena.

Millfall on the Microsoft Store (Windows PC): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd
